title: Account Manager, Exeter
description:
BUILD YOUR SALES CAREER WITH ASD EXETER

Internal Sales Executive - Account Management

Exeter (EX5 1 BA) Full-time Monday to Friday

LOCAL TEAM

BIG OPPORTUNITIES

A CAREER YOU CAN GROW

Ready for your next step in sales? Join ASD Ltd in Exeter and develop your skills alongside an experienced, supportive team that knows its customers and its industry.

We're an established steel and metals stockholder serving businesses across Devon, the South West and beyond. Our Exeter operation brings together local relationships and hands-on expertise, backed by the scale and strength of a major European business.

You don't need a background in steel. If you enjoy working with customers, have a positive attitude and want to learn, we'd like to hear from you.

The opportunity

This is a varied, office-based sales role where you'll look after customer accounts, respond to enquiries, prepare quotations and spot opportunities to grow the business. You'll learn about our products and markets from knowledgeable colleagues while developing your own commercial confidence and customer relationships.

What you'll do
- Build lasting relationships with existing customers and develop new business opportunities.
- Handle enquiries, prepare accurate quotations and convert opportunities into orders.
- Manage and grow your own customer accounts through proactive contact and great service.
- Work with colleagues to achieve sales and margin targets and resolve customer queries.
- Keep CRM and sales records accurate; support orders through to payment, including account queries.
- Develop your product knowledge, pricing skills and understanding of market trends.

What you'll bring
- Experience in sales, customer service, sales support or administration.
- Confident communication, good organisation and a helpful, proactive approach.
- Good numerical ability, attention to detail and confidence with Microsoft Excel and business systems
- Experience with SAP, CRM or order-processing software is an advantage, not essential.
- An interest in learning, taking ownership and growing your sales and commercial skills.
- Steel, metals or manufacturing experience would be useful, but transferable experience from other sectors is equally welcome.

Why join ASD Exeter?
- Learn from an experienced local team that shares its knowledge and supports each other.
- Build valuable sales, product and commercial skills in a role with real responsibility.
- Enjoy the feel of a local business with the backing of a major European organisation.
- Make a visible contribution by developing relationships and growing your own accounts.

What you'll get

A competitive salary plus life assurance; contributory pension (5% employee contribution matched by the company), Medicash healthcare plan, retail and restaurant discounts, gym and health club discounts, holiday trading, cycle to work scheme, employee assistance programme and financial well being support.

The practical details

37 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with office hours to be agreed. You'll work on site in Exeter (EX5 1 BA), so you should be within reasonable daily commuting distance.

Safety is a priority in our industry. Pre-employment and ongoing drug and alcohol testing applies, with a zero-tolerance policy.

Ready to get started?

You don't need to have your whole career mapped out. Bring your enthusiasm, willingness to learn and drive to succeed and build your future with ASD Exeter.

title: Customer Service Receptionist
description:
Amour Recruitment are pleased to be recruiting for an experienced Customer Service Receptionist on behalf of our client based in Exeter

This is an exciting opportunity to join a well-established, family-run business specialising in the repair and maintenance of commercial vehicles and trailers. Working as part of a busy depot team, you'll be the first point of contact for customers, supporting workshop operations, coordinating service bookings and ensuring a first-class customer experience throughout every stage of the repair and servicing process.

This is a varied and fast-paced role that would suit someone who thrives in a customer-facing environment, enjoys multitasking and takes pride in keeping things organised and running smoothly. Full training will be provided on company systems and processes.

Responsibilities:
- Meeting and greeting customers in person, by telephone and email.
- Managing service bookings, scheduled servicing, MOT and tachograph appointments.
- Coordinating vehicle breakdowns and keeping customers updated throughout the process.
- Maintaining electronic job cards and workshop management systems.
- Liaising closely with workshop teams to monitor progress and communicate updates.
- Obtaining customer authorisations, preparing estimates and ensuring completed work is ready for invoicing.
- Processing completed jobs and forwarding documentation for payment.
- Receiving and allocating parts and consumables to relevant jobs.
- Monitoring courtesy vehicles and company vehicle usage.
- Providing administrative support to the workshop, service and parts departments.
- Supporting customer retention through excellent service and communication.

Requirements:
- Minimum 2 years' experience within the automotive industry.
- Previous experience within a service, reception or dealership environment.
- Excellent customer service and communication skills.
- Professional and confident telephone manner.
- Good IT skills and ability to learn new systems quickly.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Ability to prioritise workload and remain calm in a busy environment.
- Proactive and positive approach to work.
- A genuine desire to build a long-term career within the automotive sector.

Hours:

Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 6:00pm (30-minute unpaid lunch break)
Every third Saturday, 8:00am - 12:00pm
Flexible start and finish times may be considered.

Salary: £30,000 to £34,000 DOE

Benefits:
- 28 days annual leave including bank holidays.
- Enhanced annual leave with length of service.
- NEST Pension Scheme.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.
- Additional benefits available after 12 months' service, subject to eligibility.

If you're an experienced customer service professional with automotive industry experience and are looking to join a growing business that genuinely values its employees, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply today and the Amour Recruitment team will be in touch.

title: Finance Administrator
description:
Finance Administrator - 6-Month Contract

Exeter, Devon
28,000- 30,000 Pro Rata
6-Month Fixed-Term Contract Full-Time

We're recruiting an experienced Finance Administrator for an established supplier of heating, HVAC and renewable energy solutions based in Exeter.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and detail-oriented finance professional to support a busy finance and operations team, ensuring accurate financial records, efficient transaction processing and the smooth running of day-to-day financial administration.

The position would suit someone with experience in finance administration, accounts payable, accounts receivable or accounts assistance, ideally within an engineering, construction, distribution or technical environment.

The Role
- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the finance department
- Process supplier invoices, purchase invoices and credit notes
- Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable activities
- Reconcile supplier statements and investigate discrepancies
- Support credit control and follow up outstanding customer payments
- Process purchase orders and match invoices against orders and delivery records
- Assist with bank reconciliations and payment processing
- Maintain accurate financial records and update accounting systems
- Support month-end procedures and financial reporting
- Liaise with customers, suppliers and internal departments regarding financial queries
- Maintain spreadsheets, databases and financial documentation
- Assist with expenses, filing and general finance administration
- Support the Finance Manager and wider team with additional tasks as required

The Candidate
- Previous experience as a Finance Administrator, Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or Accounts Administrator
- Experience processing invoices and maintaining financial records
- Good understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable
- Experience with supplier reconciliations and credit control advantageous
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Experience using accounting software such as Sage, Xero or similar advantageous
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- Comfortable dealing with customers, suppliers and internal departments
- Able to prioritise workloads and meet financial deadlines
- Experience within HVAC, engineering, construction or distribution beneficial but not essential
- Reliable, proactive and able to work independently
- Available for a 6-month contract

Package
- 28,000- 30,000 annual equivalent salary
- 6-month fixed-term contract
- Full-time working hours
- Exeter-based position
- Established heating and renewable energy business
- Supportive commercial and operational team
- Opportunity to gain experience within the building services sector

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Finance Administrator looking for a 6-month contract within an established technical business in Exeter.

You'll play an important role in supporting the finance function, ensuring invoices are processed accurately, accounts are maintained and financial administration runs efficiently.

The position offers varied responsibilities across purchase ledger, sales ledger, reconciliations and general accounts administration, working closely with the finance and operational teams.

Candidates with experience in finance administration, accounts assistance, purchase ledger, sales ledger or credit control are encouraged to apply.
